question: Why is the daily boot an amd64 live CD, and why does the dashboard score the amd64 probe instead of the i386 probe?
allowedInputs: The tree as it stood before this change, including KiSystemCallEntry64, the syscall name list, and the dashboard publisher
Serial logs from booting this tree: output/syscall-diff/reactos.log and output/driver/load.log
The Windows 10 22H2 probe log output/syscall-diff/windows.log, counted only because it contains DIFF END OK
The user report that the live CD reached the desktop and that both probe runs printed DIFF END OK

cursor.prompt: Milestone 6: amd64 boot. Implement the plan as specified. Continue until the live CD, the x64 probe, and one Windows DriverEntry result are done.

measuredEffect.metric: amd64 probe names with the same status on Windows 10 22H2 and the ReactOS live CD
measuredEffect.note: The previous committed snapshot was an i386 score of 78.2. It is not a before value for this metric. The Windows null.sys DriverEntry result was 0xC0000035 and is not part of the probe score.
